title: Regular integral models of Shimura varieties and a conjecture of Pappas
summary: We construct regular integral models for a class of Shimura varieties of symplectic and orthogonal type with maximal parahoric level at an odd prime $p$. These models are defined over the ring of integers of the reflex field and have special fiber with normal crossings and irreducible components of multiplicity one or two. Our construction uses explicit equivariant modifications of the corresponding canonical local models for symplectic and split even orthogonal similitude groups, with the minuscule cocharacters corresponding to maximal isotropic Grassmannians.
